== Summary ==
Slip “•Bo-Katan’s Gauntlet Starfighter” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 75, 1624, 798)). Version [[Bo-Katan's Gauntlet Starfighter]] (Original). Not a recreation.
